title: Fair ticket resale
summary: Resell event tickets at fair prices, no scalpers.
whyItFails: Primary ticketers control inventory. They own the tickets. Scalpers adapt. Bots and fraud persist. Low margins. Fair pricing limits revenue.
whatWouldChange: Regulation enforcing price caps and transfer controls.

attempts.outcome: Shut down abruptly, leaving tickets in limbo

attempts.notes: Face-value-or-less resale and official partner for some big tours; Ticketmaster and AEG then launched their own fan-to-fan exchanges.

reasons.detail: Primary ticketers control inventory: They own the tickets.
Scalpers adapt: Bots and fraud persist.
Low margins: Fair pricing limits revenue.
